title: BNCI 2014-008 P300 dataset (ALS patients)
description: EEG recordings from eight people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. Participants copy-spelled seven predefined five-character words on a 6x6 matrix using row-column intensification. The dataset was collected to study how attention and working memory relate to P300-BCI performance in ALS. It provides preprocessed epochs with target and non-target events.
methods_description: Eight EEG channels (Fz, Cz, Pz, Oz, P3, P4, PO7, PO8) were recorded at 256 Hz with a g.MOBILAB amplifier and active g.Ladybird Ag/AgCl electrodes, using BCI2000. The reference was the right earlobe and the ground the left mastoid. Online filtering was 0.1-10 Hz bandpass plus a 50 Hz notch. Stimulus onset asynchrony was 250 ms. Epochs of 0-1 s were baseline-corrected, and epochs exceeding ±70 μV were rejected. Classification used stepwise linear discriminant analysis (SWLDA).
